title: Chemical analysis of the Red Pyramid staining

tellings.quote: Fast forward 5 years, we now have chemical analysis data that was taken of this staining on the walls of the Red Pyramid that conclusively proves it has absolutely nothing to do with bats.

plain: Staining on the inner walls of the Red Pyramid at Dahshur in Egypt, by this account, has "absolutely nothing to do with bats", which he says chemical analysis done around 2022 "conclusively proves". Geoffrey Drumm, who says an alien told him what the pyramids were for, tells Michels this without naming who did the analysis or where it was published. If true, the stains would need some other cause, which Drumm ties to his own view of what the pyramid did.
